mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS below 3.0%) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 3.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Core CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL exceeding 195.0) signals persistent price pressures that trigger aggressive Fed tightening expectations, increasing equity discount rates and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 195.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous weakness in housing starts (HOUST < 2200) and retail sales (RSAFS < 340000) indicates broad consumer demand deterioration, triggering profit margin contraction and negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST < 2200 and RSAFS < 340000, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0%) creates conditions for Fed rate cuts, reducing discount rates and supporting equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Robust industrial production (INDPRO above 115.0) reflects strong economic activity and corporate profitability, supporting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO > 115.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Declining housing starts (HOUST < 2200) signals weakening consumer demand, reducing corporate revenue expectations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 2200, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 2.5%) and core CPI (CPIAUCSL > 195.0) signal aggressive monetary tightening amid persistent inflation, reducing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 2.5 and CPIAUCSL > 195.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Strong payroll growth (PAYEMS > 133000) indicates a tight labor market that fuels wage inflation and triggers Fed rate hike expectations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS > 133000, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.
